title: Viveka 1.0
subtitle: Reducing hallucinations in LLMs through mechanistic interpretability
description: Addressing hallucinations in large language models through mechanistic interpretability — dissecting neural network internals to uncover why models produce factually incorrect outputs. Awarded grants from VCs and ExceptionRaised.

title: Deep Recall
subtitle: Semantic search & retrieval for IIT Madras historical archives
description: A scalable system that indexes and retrieves historical records from the IIT Madras Archive Center using embeddings, OCR, knowledge graphs, and frameworks like LangChain, GraphRAG, and FAISS.

title: SpeechSeek
subtitle: Speaker diarization with emotion & language detection for Indic languages
description: An advanced speaker diarization system with integrated emotion and language detection, designed to handle complex code-mixed speech and support multiple Indic languages — one of the most challenging problems in neural audio processing.

title: Viveka 2.0
subtitle: Interpreting and advancing abstract reasoning models
description: We mechanistically interpret efficient and performant architectures on Abstraction Reasoning Corpus and build on top of them. ARC AGI is a benchmark of puzzles that evaluates an AI model's reasoning capabilities that are trivial for humans but hard for current data-hungry AI systems.

title: triton::cu
subtitle: High-performance GPU kernels for AI workloads
description: triton::cu is a project done in collaboration with KLA. The aim of the project is to make an agentic pipeline capable of converting Triton code into CUDA code. CUDA code gives the programmer lower level control and therefore the code can be optimized more than Triton code.

title: KathAI
description: Building an intelligent conversational system for low-resource languages by combining retrieval-augmented generation, translation, and speech processing. KathAI aims to make collected stories and language resources searchable and accessible while exploring audio cleaning, transcription, alignment, and speech-based interaction.

title: AI Rahman
description: Music Information retrieval is one of the polarizing areas in the field of AI today. A number of sequence to sequence based models have been explored for single track music generation, but bringing in multiple instruments together for the generation of multi-track music composition is yet a challenge. It requires a mechanism that maintains the coherence while generating music. By means of this project, we aim to explore models that are able to coherently fuse two different genres and create pleasant music.

title: Night Vision
description: Low light conditions often degrade the quality of images and videos, making it challenging for various applications such as CCTV surveillance and satellite imaging. This project aims to address the problem by enhancing low light videos using deep learning techniques. Specifically, we will be working with CNNs, GANs, diffusion models, object detection algorithms (eg. YOLO), temporal convolutional networks for improving the visibility and quality of videos captured in low light environments.

title: Suncast
description: High-energy solar flares and coronal mass ejections (CMEs) have the potential to disrupt Earth’s satellite infrastructure significantly. Predicting these events in advance could enable the activation of defense mechanisms to mitigate their effects. Since these phenomena often originate from regions of the solar surface associated with sunspots, predicting sunspots is also crucial. By leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to predict sunspots, we aim to achieve enhanced prediction accuracy in this domain.

title: Text 2 Scene
description: The project developed a novel image editing tool that allows the user to make changes to a sample image using English text. We used masking and impainting, followed by harmonization to achieve this in a photo-realistic fashion.

title: Spike Drive
description: The project aimed to utilise Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) to identify moving objects. We successfully implemented a Convolution SNN on the DVS Gesture Dataset achieving an accuracy of 78%.

title: RL Games
description: The project explored Reinforcement Learning Algorithms and Deep Reinforcement learning techniques such as PPO, SAC etc, in complex environments ranging from MineRL to Mario.

title: Deepfake Detection
description: The project utilises the SeqFakeFormer architecture to trace and detect deepfakes. The pipeline involves CNNs to capture feature manipulations and cross attention models to capture sequential manipulations.

title: OptiWing
description: The Project is based on AI applications in the field of Aerospace Engineering and Airfoil design. We tested out different model pipelines to generate robust and smooth airfoils given the corresponding 'Cp' vs 'X' plots.

title: AI Choreography
description: The project aimed to generate realisable dance moves for music inputs provided. We implemented a Spatial Temporal GCN and used cross-attention models to establish the relationship between audio and motion features.
